objectives: Predict gold, silver, bronze, and total medal counts, and name first-time medalists.
constraints: Medal counts are nonnegative, and a zero is a truncation rather than a small count.

parameter_estimation.method: Tobit for the truncated count, Mundlak means for the time-invariant terms, a probit hurdle at 0.3, then particle swarm optimization

steps: Split projects into advantageous, disadvantageous, and neutral.
Forecast event counts with SARIMAX or ARIMA.
Fit the Tobit-Mundlak model on countries with medals.
Fit the Hurdle on countries under ten medals, and call a first medal when the probability clears 0.3.
Optimize the truncated prediction with particle swarm optimization.

assumptions: Athletes active after 2020 are at peak and will compete.
Event counts in 2028 and 2032 are only the host effect and international trends.
Regime-change results are folded into the current countries.
A medal is scored 3, 2, 1 by task, and also scored 1 in the 2024 check.

identifiability_feasibility.analysis: The paper reports an accuracy and an R-squared. It does not show a trace or a condition number.

First medals: Tobit 0 percent, Hurdle 37.5 percent, three of eight.

objectives: Estimate the great-coach effect and name three countries and the sports where a coach pays.
constraints: Medal counts are nonnegative, and a zero is a truncation rather than a small count.

parameter_estimation.method: event-study DID, logistic regression for the treatment probability, inverse probability weights, then a double robust estimator

steps: Find periods where a medal count jumps.
Match the jump to a named coach and a tenure.
Fit the dynamic DID with leads and lags.
Weight by the logistic treatment probability.
Combine the regression and the weights in the double robust estimator.

assumptions: A coach is treated as a policy change.
Treatment times differ across countries, so a two-period DID is not enough.
One of the two estimators may be misspecified and the other still consistent.

objectives: Separate the former host effect from the subsequent host effect, and revise the 2028 forecast.

parameter_estimation.method: BE is 1 one cycle before hosting, on an average of 7 years. AF is a decay factor on the next three Games.

steps: Set BE to 1 on the Games before a known hosting, else 0.
Apply a decay factor to the three Games after hosting.
Refit and compare with the original forecast.

assumptions: A country knows it will host one cycle ahead, on average 7 years.
The host can fall below its normal level after hosting.
